agentic.title: Agentic score
agentic.description: How usable your storefront is to an AI agent, scored by Is Agentic across discovery, accessibility, usability, and agentic payments.

scan.title: Run a scan
scan.description: Every scan reads your live storefront. Results are stored here so you can watch the score move.
scan.never: This store has not been scanned yet.

blocked.running: A scan is already running for this store. It will appear here when it lands.
blocked.cooldown: This store was scanned recently. The next scan is available {when}.

scan.disclosure: Scans are run by Is Agentic, a free public service from Vercel Labs. Your storefront domain is sent to is-agentic.com; no customer or order data leaves ecentic.

score.title: Where you stand
score.description: The score is Is Agentic's, shown unchanged. Layers are ordered by what matters most to a store.
score.attribution: View the full report on is-agentic.com
score.empty: Run your first scan to see how agents read this storefront.
score.publicOnly: Is Agentic already holds a public report for this domain, scoring {score} / 100 — {label}. Run a scan to pull in the full check-by-check detail and start tracking the trend.
score.fixesNote: This list is Is Agentic's, ranked by the points each fix is worth. Items about API specs, SDKs, or developer portals apply to the whole domain, not to your catalog — start with the ones ecentic can take on.
score.publicOnlyUnscored: Is Agentic holds a report for this domain but has not scored it yet — {label}. Run a scan to pull in the full check-by-check detail and start tracking the trend.
score.trendSummary: {count} scans since {since}, from {first} to {latest} out of 100.

journey.title: What an agent actually did
journey.description: Is Agentic sends a real agent at this storefront and records the walk. That map is supporting evidence — it does not change the numeric score.
journey.empty: No agent walk is on record for this domain yet. It appears on the Is Agentic report once a run finishes.
journey.running: An agent is walking this storefront now. The map fills in as it goes.

checks.title: Every check
checks.description: The evidence behind the score, grouped by layer. Checks that do not apply to a storefront are listed last with the reason.
checks.notApplicable: This check does not apply to your storefront.
checks.empty: Run a scan to see the full check list.

competitors.title: How rivals score
competitors.description: The same scan run against the storefronts behind your selected competitors. Each domain has its own scan cooldown, so checking a rival never uses up your own.
competitors.empty: No competitor storefronts yet. Add competitors and ecentic will scan the domains behind them.

methodology.title: How this score works
methodology.description: Is Agentic's own description of the scoring model, read live from their MCP server.
